title: Slot booking
goal: Turn the page into a booking sheet for one day. There are four slots: 9:00, 10:00, 11:00 and 12:00. Bookings are stored on the server as `Booking` nodes connected to root, with fields `slot: str` and `name: str`. The page has a text input with the placeholder "Your name". Each free slot shows a button labelled "Book SLOT". Clicking it books the slot under the typed name; the slot then shows "SLOT: booked by NAME" and its Book button is gone. A slot that is already booked cannot be booked again, also when the server is asked directly. Stored bookings are shown when the page loads. You may remove the Ping button.
